assignment: original ordinal modulo 4; original order within worker
backend_scope_string: Unchanged executed discovery backend requires AUTHORIZED_DISCOVERY_768_ONLY; outer authority restricts this run to remaining390. No old full-batch entrypoint imported.
operational_delta: 4 workers and minimum4CPU/8GiB instead of old1;12-hour wall ceiling and per-cell/search/context budgets preserved; pause completion grace1050s derived from cell900+context120+30. Runtime resource loss pauses. Not scientific thresholds.
preservation: Old377 + original interrupted ordinal377 byte-readonly. This release starts only original ordinals378..767 once in a new namespace. No confirmation/no labels/no network.

sample_semantics.auxiliary_cost: C64=min(T_ok,64); T_ok=+infinity for hard failure or no normal completion. Missing evidence=null/HOLD; no discount.
sample_semantics.auxiliary_not_loss: C64, hard-event frequency, sampled clearance and command smoothness kept separately; no weighted mixture, no substituted reward.
sample_semantics.change_from_old_target: New target-generator branch explicitly replaces random short-tree target with forced-first-action native-policy execution for candidate labels ONLY; old datasets/checkpoints are untouched.
sample_semantics.complete_sample_qualification: Complete sampled returns do not prove that the policy terminates almost surely or that the infinite-horizon expectation is known.
sample_semantics.definition: Q_128^pi(s,a)=E[sum_{k=0}^{min(128,tau)-1}0.99^k r_k | s, forced first a, then pi]
sample_semantics.long_return_label_eligibility: All planned repetitions for both compared actions valid and truly terminated; any artificial cutoff makes that action long-return-label UNKNOWN. Its finite-window observations remain in outputs.
sample_semantics.name: Q128_NATIVE_B64_H8_COMPOSITE_POLICY_RETURN_CANDIDATE_V1
sample_semantics.network_output: 16 unconstrained ranking scores for canonical actions, not calibrated Q/leaf values/safety probabilities
sample_semantics.reward_policy: Use each episode exact frozen reward/transition context; do not copy C06 numbers into C04 or C11. Context must be bound before scientific START.
sample_semantics.value_semantics: finite-window fixed-policy composite return; not optimal Q, not internal UCT child Q

stop_policy: User pause file stops dispatch after each current cell; deadline/fault stops new dispatch. Controller handles only its owned children; no auto-retry. Max grace1050s then own hung process termination can leave a partial cell.
timing: Only new-batch phase/process/cell timings, no claim of matched speedup against old377; do not synthesize missing old timings.
